data.title: mTORC1 induces purine synthesis through control of the mitochondrial tetrahydrofolate cycle
data.authors: Ben-Sahra I; Hoxhaj G; Ricoult SJH; Asara JM; Manning BD

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: mTORC1 promotes purine synthesis via ATF4-driven mitochondrial tetrahydrofolate metabolism.
data.abstract_excerpt: In response to growth signals, mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) stimulates anabolic processes underlying cell growth. We found that mTORC1 increases metabolic flux through the de novo purine synthesis pathway in various mouse and human cells, thereby influencing the nucleotide pool available for nucleic acid synthesis.
